Lakeshore Orthopedic Associates
Consultation Report
Patient: Morgan Ashby-Vale
Date of Birth: 02/17/1981
Date of Service: 05/09/2025
Provider: Dr. Priya Okonkwo-Lind

Referral Reason: Evaluation for persistent low back pain and radicular symptoms.
Patient presents for orthopedic consultation regarding a work injury.
The injury occurred on 03/11/2025 while the patient was working at Quarry Ridge Logistics LLC.
The patient describes the mechanism of injury as lifting a plastic tote from a floor level pallet.
Initial symptoms were low back pain.
Patient reports seeking care at Brightwater Family Medicine on 03/14/2025.
Subsequent treatment included physical therapy at Ridgeline Physical Therapy.
The patient attended initial PT evaluation on 03/24/2025.
A follow up PT progress note was documented on 04/14/2025.
Lakeshore Imaging provided an MRI on 04/18/2025.
The MRI findings were reviewed during this consultation.
Physical examination was performed today, 05/09/2025.
Motor strength was graded 4/5 bilaterally in lower extremities.
Reflexes were intact throughout the lower extremities.
Sensation was preserved in all dermatomes tested.
Positive straight leg raise on the left at 45 degrees.
The patient reports pain radiating down the left leg.
Impression: L4-L5 disc protrusion with left L5 radiculopathy.
The patient remains symptomatic despite current conservative management.
Further imaging or intervention may be considered based on the plan.
